# A2A `a2a.proto` at `v1.0.1`

The normative A2A protocol definition, vendored verbatim as the oracle for the A2A wire
conformance check in `crates/capsule-runtime/src/a2a_conformance.rs`.

Do not edit this file. Replace it only with the same file at another pinned tag, in a directory
named for that tag, and record its source URL and sha256 here.
